description:
Register, update, decompose, inspect, or abandon hierarchical goals and task DAGs (actions: create, update, decompose, get, list, abandon). Use set_goal instead of manage_intentions when formulating multi-step objectives and sub-goal DAGs rather than queueing concrete execution directives.

Returns goal record, sub-goal hierarchy, completion progress, or goal lists.

action.description: The goal management operation to perform: create, update, decompose, get, list, abandon

client_request_id.description: Idempotency key to prevent duplicate creation

id.description: Goal ID (required for update, get, abandon)

limit.description: Max items to return for list action

parent_id.description: Parent goal ID for hierarchical sub-goals

subgoals.description: Array of sub-goals for decompose action

name: set_goal
